t: This is the Ivy House, a Grade II listed pub at 40 Stuart Road in Nunhead. It is London's first co-operatively owned pub. It was also the first in the UK bought on behalf of a community using the right to bid provisions of the Localism Act 2011. The architect was A. E. Sewell, who worked as in-house architect for Truman's Brewery and designed around fifty pubs. His career peaked in the 1920s and 1930s, and at least five pubs from that period are now listed by Historic England.
